Never widen the framing to show a hidden support, hand or leg; a limb crossing the edge runs naturally on past it, never cut off or fading out inside the image.

Its architecture, props, light and weather show the world; no creatures, no second character, no readable text other than her element's own symbol and atomic number. SCENE (chosen):

Outfit: a large bath towel wrapped securely under the arms
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
BOTH HANDS: both hands clasp loosely together in front of her chest.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: raised inner brows, wide unsettled eyes, mouth slightly open, faint blush across the cheeks and nose.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more bare shoulder and collarbone inside the crop; the crop stays exactly where CROP sets it and never moves down to show more; cover the chest

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, armor, regalia, ornaments, mecha plates or background. ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera exactly as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Au) and atomic number (79) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
